Bacon Butter Cheeseburgers
By: Janis Smyth
Published: Tuesday, August 17, 2010 - 7:02am

Ingredients




2 pounds 80/20 ground chuck
1/2 cup unsalted butter, room temperature
1 teaspoon salt
1/2 teaspoon freshly ground black pepper
1/4 cup of your favorite steak sauce
1/2 pound bacon, fried and fat reserved
sliced cheese
condiments of choice: lettuce, tomatoes, pickles, onions, mayonnaise, mustard, ketchup, etc (and buns if you insist)

Preparation

1 In a large bowl, gently mix the beef, butter, salt, pepper and steak sauce until well blended, but don’t over-handle the meat. Form 6 to 8 patties, place them on a platter, cover with plastic wrap and allow them to rest for about 10 minutes. 2 Heat the bacon fat in a large skillet or griddle until sizzling, and fry the hamburger patties to desired doneness, flipping once.  (Never press down on a hamburger with a spatula to speed the cooking process – you’ll be squeezing all the good-tasting stuff right out of it!) 3 As they finish cooking, allow the burgers to rest, placed on paper towels, for a few minutes before serving.
